app.name: Sutradhar
app.sampleDataNotice: Records shown here are sample data standing in for an official records system. This is not a live government database.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Sign in with the mobile number registered for your office.

errors.mobileFormat: Enter the 10-digit mobile number registered for your office.
errors.invalid_credentials: That mobile number and password do not match. Check both and try again.
errors.network: Could not reach the system. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong at our end. Please try again in a moment.
errors.roleRequired: Choose whether you are signing in as an officer or as a head of department.
errors.role_mismatch: Your mobile number and password are correct, but this account is not registered for the role you chose. Choose the other one and sign in again.

login.visualCaption: Three checks run against the records at the same time. Everything they find is gathered and handed to you. Nothing is decided until you decide it.
login.visualTitle: Checked by the system. Decided by you.
login.roleHint: Choose how you are registered in this office.

home.title: Your desk
home.emptyBody: When you upload a document it will appear here once the checks have run.

footer.tagline: Sutradhar prepares the decision. A person makes it.
